verdict.rationale: Foreign qualification is a fair question for a registered-agent and corporate-services provider like CSC, so the axis applies. The evidence covers registered agent coverage in all 50 states, annual report filing and a secretary of state forms library. None of it documents CSC preparing or submitting foreign-qualification filings when a company expands into a new state. The forms library is an adjacent self-service tool, and annual report filing is a different capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider handles the foreign-qualification filing when the company registers to do business in an additional state
